submission.justification: Provisional recommendation only. Absorber-F2 at 5 mm gives the best simulated energy resolution at 100 GeV in the scan (3.381%, against 3.443% at 3 mm, 3.778% at 2 mm, 3.809% at 7 mm and 4.623% at 10 mm). Absorber-F3 and Absorber-F1 were worse at every thickness tested. The hard dose-rate constraint (at most 20 uSv/h at 1 m after one week of cooldown) is NOT verified. No project document with activation or dose data was found, no material/thickness combination was screened for dose, and dose_compliance_confirmed = 0. The F2 choice must not be adopted for hands-on maintenance until an activation/dose calculation confirms compliance at 5 mm. If F2 fails, the next candidates would have to be checked in the same way. Also note a discrepancy: the "_2025" keyed resolution values (F2 3.2, F3 3.9, F1 5.1 at 5 mm) differ from the direct scan values (3.381, 3.82, 5.254). The ranking is the same under both, but the source of the 2025 values is not documented, so I used the scan values.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV

requirements.requirement: HARD: residual dose rate at 1 m after one week of cooldown <= 20 uSv/h

Compliance for F2 at 5 mm (and for any other option) has not been established.
